Building a Graph-Aware Logseq Memory Layer for an OpenClaw Agent
为 OpenClaw 代理构建一个图感知 Logseq 内存层

Al Craig

Al Craig
艾尔·克雷格

Published Mar 21, 2026
发表于2026年3月21日
+ Follow + 关注

I’ve been working on a pattern for giving an OpenClaw agent a more useful memory system by combining standard markdown memory with a Logseq graph. Now I am posting some of my notes here - as a recipe for others who may be interested and may want to try doing this themselves.
我一直在研究一种模式，通过将标准标记存储器与Logseq图结合，为OpenClaw代理提供更实用的内存系统。 现在我把一些笔记发在这里——作为食谱，供感兴趣并想尝试的人参考。

The goal is not just “save notes to Logseq.” 目标不仅仅是“把笔记保存到Logseq”。

The goal is to create a memory layer that lets the agent: 目标是创建一个内存层，使代理能够：

  • journal recent work cleanly 日志 近期工作清晰
  • grow connected concept pages over time 随着时间推移，概念页面不断建立联系
  • retrieve context through graph structure, not just keyword search 通过图结构获取上下文，而不仅仅是关键词搜索
  • follow backlinks and linked concepts when relevant 在相关时关注反向链接和链接概念
  • distinguish between active-session logging and idle-time knowledge graph maintenance 区分主动会话日志和闲置知识图谱维护

Done well, this starts to feel less like a chatbot writing notes and more like a system with a developing working memory. 如果做得好，这会让它感觉不像聊天机器人写笔记，更像是一个拥有正在发展的工作记忆系统。

Why Logseq? 为什么选择Logseq？

Logseq is an open source note-taking and knowledge management tool that helps you organise ideas as connected, linkable thoughts rather than isolated documents. In particular, it has the following features:
Logseq 是一款开源的笔记和知识管理工具，帮助你将想法组织成相互关联、可链接的思路，而非孤立的文档。 具体来说，它具有以下特点：

  • journals + concept pages + backlinks are a strong fit for agent memory 期刊 + 概念页 + 反向链接非常适合代理记忆
  • inline [[links]] make relationships explicit 内联 [[链接]] 使关系显现
  • graph growth creates a base for richer future retrieval 图的增长为更丰富的未来检索奠定基础
  • it supports outliner-style thinking, which maps well to agent journaling and selective knowledge distillation (I think it is better suited to this use than Obsidian) 它支持大纲式思维，这与代理日志和选择性知识提炼非常契合（我认为它比Obsidian更适合这种用途）

The broad architecture 整体架构

1. File memory 1. 文件存储器

  • normal OpenClaw markdown memory files (for curated memory and recent daily continuity) 普通 OpenClaw 标记内存文件（用于策划内存和近期每日连续性）

2. Logseq graph memory 2. Logseq 图存储器

  • journal pages 期刊页
  • concept pages 概念页
  • backlinks 反向链接
  • inline linked concepts 内联链接概念

3. Heartbeat logic 3. 心跳逻辑

  • if there was meaningful activity: append a concise journal update 如果有有意义的活动：附上简明的日志更新
  • if not: find one graph gap and improve it 如果没有：找出一个图间隙并加以改进

4. Graph-aware retrieval 4. 图感知检索

  • find the primary page 查找主页
  • pull a small relevant linked neighbourhood 拉取一个小型相关的关联邻域
  • avoid expanding the whole graph unless the task really needs it 除非任务真的需要扩展，否则避免扩展整个图表

What made this practical 是什么让这变得实用

The key was using a Logseq MCP server and then giving the agent explicit, reliable instructions for how to use it. 关键是使用 Logseq MCP 服务器，然后向代理提供明确且可靠的使用指令。

In this setup, the MCP server is the Joel Hooks Logseq MCP server/tooling path. The practical lesson here is that the README alone is not always enough; the live tool schema and direct rendering tests matter just as much.
在此配置中，MCP服务器即为Joel Hooks Logseq的MCP服务器/工具路径。这里的实际教训是，仅靠README并不总是足够;实时工具架构和直接渲染测试同样重要。

A few patterns that helped 有几个对我有帮助的图案

  • prefer outliner-friendly nested bullets over giant markdown dumps 更喜欢适合大纲的嵌套项目，而不是巨大的折扣数据
  • use inline [[double bracket]] links for important concepts 使用内联[[双括号]]链接查看重要概念
  • treat active journaling and idle graph growth as different behaviors 把主动写日记和闲置图增长当作不同的行为来看待
  • keep heartbeat single-writer if multiple models/agents are in play 如果有多个模型/代理人参与，保持心跳为单一写作者
  • let the live MCP schema be the source of truth, not assumptions 让实时MCP模式成为真理的来源，而非假设

Installing OpenClaw 安装 OpenClaw

Assuming a Linux environment, the rough flow is: 假设使用Linux环境，大致流程如下：

  1. install OpenClaw 安装 OpenClaw
  2. complete onboarding 完整的入职流程
  3. verify the workspace exists 验证工作空间的存在
  4. verify the agent can use exec 验证代理是否能使用 exec
  5. install/configure the Logseq MCP server 安装/配置Logseq MCP服务器
  6. connect it through mcporter (this is part of OpenClaw) 通过McPorter连接（这是OpenClaw的一部分）
  7. wrap usage instructions in an AgentSkill so the agent uses it consistently 将使用指令包裹在AgentSkill中，使agent能够持续使用该指令

If you already have OpenClaw installed, you can skip to the MCP portions. 如果你已经安装了OpenClaw，可以直接跳到MCP部分。

Installing / wiring the Logseq MCP server 安装/布线Logseq MCP服务器

The exact deployment method may vary, but the practical pattern is: 具体的部署方法可能有所不同，但实际模式如下：

  • have a working Logseq graph 有一个可工作的Logseq图
  • run the Joel Hooks Logseq MCP server/tooling in a form that mcporter can call 运行 Joel Hooks Logseq MCP 服务器/工具，格式为 McPorter 可调用的形式
  • confirm the available tools with the live schema 用实时模式确认可用工具

In practice, I’d always start by checking: 实际上，我总是先检查： 

npx -y mcporter list logseq --schema

That tells you what tools are actually available in your environment. 这告诉你环境中实际可用的工具有哪些。

Typical read/inspect tools you want: 你常用的常见阅读/检查工具：

  • logseq.getAllPages
  • logseq.searchPages logseq.search页面
  • logseq.getPage
  • logseq.getBacklinks
  • logseq.findKnowledgeGaps
  • logseq.analyzeGraph

Typical write/improve tools you want: 你常用的写作/改进工具：

  • logseq.addJournalContent
  • logseq.addJournalBlock
  • logseq.addNoteContent logseq.addNote内容
  • logseq.createPage

Configuring mcporter 配置mcporter

The practical pattern is to register the Logseq MCP server in your mcporter config, then verify with: 实际操作的模式是先在你的mcporter配置中注册Logseq MCP服务器，然后用以下方式验证： 

npx -y mcporter list --json

Once the server is visible, test it with read-only calls first, for example: 一旦服务器可见，先用只读调用测试，例如： 

npx -y mcporter call logseq.getAllPages        
npx -y mcporter call logseq.searchPages query="OpenClaw"        
npx -y mcporter call logseq.getPage pageName="Contents"

Then test a small write, ideally to a non-critical page or today’s journal page. 然后测试一篇小写作，最好是写在非批判性的页面或当日的日记页。

One important lesson: avoid inventing tool names. Use the schema you actually have. 一个重要的教训：避免发明工具名称。用你实际拥有的模式。

Wrapping it as a skill 把它包装成一种技能

This is where the setup really becomes usable. 这时设置才真正实用。

Instead of expecting the agent to “just know” how to use the MCP server, create a dedicated skill that teaches: 与其期望代理“只是会用”MCP服务器，不如创建一个专门的技能来教授：

  • which Logseq tools exist 这些Logseq工具存在
  • which write methods render well in the app 哪些方法在应用中渲染得很好
  • preferred journaling format 首选的日志格式
  • active vs idle heartbeat behaviour 主动心跳与空闲心跳行为
  • graph-aware retrieval rules 图感知检索规则
  • pitfalls to avoid 需要避免的陷阱

For example, the skill should tell the agent to prefer concrete shell commands such as: 例如，技能应告诉代理优先使用具体的壳级命令，如： 

npx -y mcporter call logseq.getPage pageName="Contents"

and for journaling, to prefer small structured writes such as: 而在日志中，则偏好小型结构化写入，如： 

npx -y mcporter call logseq.addJournalContent content="- [HEARTBEAT] 14:30\n  - Worked on [[Logseq MCP]] integration for [[OpenClaw]]."

rather than dumping large escaped markdown blobs. 而不是大量甩掉的降价块。

Recommended skill split 推荐的技能分配

I found it useful to separate this into two conceptual skills: 我觉得把它拆分成两个概念技能很有用：

1. Logseq MCP skill 1. Logseq MCP技能

Teaches mechanics: 教授力学：

  • how to call the server 如何调用服务器
  • available tools 可用工具
  • good write/read patterns 良好的写读模式
  • source-of-truth rules 真源规则

2. Logseq memory skill 2. Logseq 记忆技能

Teaches cognitive workflow: 教授认知工作流程：

  • startup recent-context check 启动近期上下文检查
  • graph-aware recall 图感知回忆
  • active vs idle heartbeat logic 主动心跳与空闲心跳逻辑
  • authorship rules for journal notes 期刊笔记的作者规则
  • selective ingestion of sources/transcripts 选择性地获取来源/转录
  • future reminders on journal pages 期刊页上的未来提醒

Why this matters 为什么这很重要

Without explicit guidance, agents tend to: 在没有明确指导的情况下，代理往往会：

  • write ugly notes 写丑陋的便条
  • over-expand the graph 过度展开图
  • invent nonexistent tools 发明不存在的工具
  • treat every source as something to ingest 把每个来源都当作可以摄入的东西
  • confuse “what happened” with “what should be remembered” 把“发生了什么”和“应该记住什么”混淆了

With a proper setup, they can become much better at: 有了合适的设置，他们可以在以下方面变得更好：

  • maintaining readable journals 保持可读的日志
  • building linked knowledge over time 随着时间构建关联知识
  • pulling back the right context when needed 必要时回溯正确的背景
  • supporting memory as a graph, not just a search index 支持内存作为图，而不仅仅是搜索索引

A couple of practical lessons 几条实用经验

  • The live MCP schema matters more than old docs. 实时MCP架构比旧文档更重要。
  • Rendering in the Logseq app matters more than raw markdown purity. Logseq 应用中的渲染比原始的 markdown 纯净度更重要。
  • Inline links are important if you want the graph to become genuinely useful later. 如果你想让图表以后真正有用，内联链接非常重要。
  • Active-session notes should be written by the session that actually did the work; heartbeat should not invent those notes later from scratch. 活跃会话笔记应由实际完成工作的会话撰写;Heartbeat不应该后来从零开始发明这些音符。
  • Idle time is best spent improving one meaningful graph gap at a time. 闲置时间最好用来逐一改善一个有意义的图间隙。

Where this gets interesting 这就变得有趣了

Once the graph is growing properly, the agent can start to: 一旦图正常增长，代理就可以开始：

  • retrieve connected context more intelligently 更智能地检索相关上下文
  • distinguish weak from strong sources 区分弱源与强源
  • selectively distill newsletters, transcripts, and notes into useful concept pages 有选择地将通讯、文字稿和笔记提炼成有用的概念页
  • gradually build a more coherent working memory over time 随着时间推移，逐渐建立起更连贯的工作记忆

I think there’s a lot of potential here for anyone building local-first, graph-aware AI workflows. 我认为这里对任何构建本地优先、图感知AI工作流程的人来说潜力巨大。

If others are experimenting with OpenClaw + Logseq + MCP, I’d be very interested to compare notes. 如果其他人在尝试OpenClaw + Logseq + MCP，我很想分享一下经验。
